description: Hainan research partners derive a ten-metre multiple-cropping index from Sentinel-2 time series using smoothing and seasonal-change detection. The ScienceDB repository title names 2016 and 2020, while the inspected description documents only the 2020 map and its ground-sample validation. CC BY 4.0 permits free reuse; the raster container is not stated. The index can represent cultivation intensity in agricultural-water demand and land-management simulations. Reported 2020 overall accuracy is 91.9 percent, which leaves classification uncertainty and does not resolve the metadata conflict about the earlier year. Cropping intensity does not directly specify crop type, yield or irrigation efficiency. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
name: A dataset of monitoring the 10 m spatial resolution multiple cropping index in Hainan Island in 2016 and 2020
